q0AnchorReason: Reads no q0. The Bloch condition d(xi) = 0 and the per-symbol classes are computed in Z[x]/(x^3-x^2+1) and Z/5^W; no substrate modulus enters.
source: CGZ arXiv:1712.04887v3 Proposition 2.5 and Definition 2.1; Addendum 33 (this repo)
scope: scope-(a) SHARPENING of Addendum 33, no new claim. Replaces that addendum's unfalsifiable obstruction argument (Lambda^2(F^x/(F^x)^3) = 0, true whatever xi is) with the genuine Bloch condition computed exactly in K = Q(alpha): the alpha-line is the exceptional unit relation 1 - alpha = alpha^{-2}, every argument is a power of alpha times a sign, K has unit rank 1 so Lambda^2 of its unit group is generated by a 2-torsion class, and d(xi) = 0 exactly over Z. IT DOES NOT PIN THE COEFFICIENTS: d vanishes for every (a, b), so (2, 1) comes from the alpha-line construction upstream, not from the Bloch condition -- recorded so the value of Addendum 33 is not read as forced. Since P_zeta is multiplicative, eps_3 is linear in the coefficients; linearity is measured against the direct product on a 3 x 3 grid rather than assumed. The per-symbol classes are kappa(P(z_1)) = 2 and kappa(P(z_2)) = 0 in the zeta_3 basis, so eps_3(a[z_1] + b[z_2]) = zeta_3^{-a} -- the raw readout is a power of the mu_24 generator, not of zeta_3, and conflating the two mislabelled the value in Addenda 33-34. Nothing wired; the m = 2 result of PR #4968 is untouched.
